name: Giaginskaya-Novokubanskaya Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length found (leg d fails); leg c also weak (reconstruction listing in a federal territorial-planning scheme, no tender/permit/FID)
researcher_notes: Existing-row check: NOT P2339. Item 353 of Annex 4 to Govt. Order 816-r (ed. 17.12.2025), 'Реконструкция магистрального газопровода Гиагинская-Новокубанская', 1.008 bcm/y, is a separate entry from item 182 'Реконструкция магистрального газопровода Майкоп - Невинномысск для проведения ВТД' (2.5 bcm/y = P2339; route Maykop-Giaginsky-Mostovskoy-Labinsky-Novokubansky(Sovetskoe)-Uspensky-Kochubeevsky). Item 353 routes Giaginsky -> Koshekhablsky (Adygea) -> Kurganinsky -> Novokubansky (Verkhnekubanskoe), i.e. a separate branch, different districts and capacity; roster has no Giaginskaya-Novokubanskaya row (P1475 Maykop-Samur-Sochi, P2381/P5665 Rostov-Maykop are other lines). Confirmed only via the 816-r annex (url_verifier OK, names pipeline, states 1.008 bcm/y). Unverified and NOT cited: a web-search snippet mentioning a Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar capital-repair survey 'МГ Гиагинская-Новокубанская, Ду300, Ру 5,4 МПа, км 0-10' (neftegaz.ru procurement pages failed url_verifier, name not found on page) - would imply DN300 and operator Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar (Maykopskoe LPUMG). No total length found; straight-line Giaginskaya-Novokubansk is roughly 100 km so likely >25 km, but unsourced so cannot qualify under the length rule. entity_lookup (gas) returns only 'Transgaz' for Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar; check owner entity if later promoted. To promote: find a sourced length (Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar/Maykopskoe LPUMG, tender documentation, Rostekhnadzor declaration) and a concrete step (reconstruction design/tender). Route: none (RouteType Unavailable (cannot find route), RouteAccuracy no route).
